questions.question: Calculate: 10 - 3 × 2 + 4² ÷ 2 - 1
questions.explanation: PEMDAS: Exponents first: 4² = 16. Then multiplication/division left to right: 3 × 2 = 6, 16 ÷ 2 = 8. Then addition/subtraction left to right: 10 - 6 + 8 - 1 = 11.
